## File: facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/evaluation/pix3d_evaluation.py

Prompts

```
['create a Pix3DEvaluator instance to evaluate bbox, segmentation, and mesh predictions on the Pix3D dataset', 'run evaluate_for_pix3d to compute box AP, mask AP, and mesh AP from model predictions', 'review transform_meshes_to_camera_coord_system which converts predicted meshes from image space to camera coordinates', 'test load_unique_meshes to parse a COCO JSON and load all unique OBJ mesh models into memory', 'summarize Pix3DEvaluator.process which collects model outputs and encodes prediction masks into RLE format']
```

Usage

```
{'create_Pix3DEvaluator': 'create a Pix3DEvaluator instance to evaluate bbox, segmentation, and mesh predictions on the Pix3D dataset', 'run_evaluate_for_pix3d': 'run evaluate_for_pix3d to compute box AP, mask AP, and mesh AP from model predictions', 'review_transform_meshes_to_camera_coord_system': 'review transform_meshes_to_camera_coord_system which converts predicted meshes from image space to camera coordinates', 'test_load_unique_meshes': 'test load_unique_meshes to parse a COCO JSON and load all unique OBJ mesh models into memory', 'summarize_Pix3DEvaluator_process': 'summarize Pix3DEvaluator.process which collects model outputs and encodes prediction masks into RLE format'}
```
